question: How do I access Blackboard from outside the campus?
expected: Open the University website, click Quick Links MyUOS, click Login, sign in with the UOS e-mail and password, verify by multi-factor authentication (SMS or Microsoft Authenticator), then the Blackboard main page opens.

question: How do I verify my identity when signing in to Blackboard?
expected: Multi-factor authentication: an SMS to the registered phone number or the Microsoft Authenticator application.

question: How can I pin a course to the top of my course list in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: Mark the course as a favourite; it is pinned to the top of the courses list.

question: What can I manage from the Details & Actions panel of a Blackboard course?
expected: Roster, groups, course image, course availability (open or private), Blackboard Collaborate, attendance, announcements.

question: What is the minimum size of a Blackboard course banner image?
expected: At least 1200 x 240 pixels and no larger than 25 KB (page 5); page 4 repeats the 1200 x 240 minimum.

question: How do I keep a Blackboard course hidden from students while I build it?
expected: Set Course Availability to Private: students see the course in their list but cannot access it; open it when ready.

question: Which file types can I upload to Blackboard course content?
expected: DOC, DOCX, HTM, HTML, MP3, MPG, PDF, PPT, PPTX, XLS, XLSX, RTF, TXT, ZIP and most image types.

question: How do I move a content item with the keyboard in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: Tab to the item's move icon, press Enter to activate move mode, use the arrow keys to choose a location, press Enter to drop it.

question: How do I add a learning module in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: Click the plus sign, click Learning Module or Folder, name it and add content; it is hidden by default and visibility can be set or conditioned.

question: How do I send an announcement to my students in Blackboard?
expected: Details and Actions, create Announcements, plus sign, title, recipients and message, optional e-mail copy, optional schedule, Save then Post.

question: How do I create an assignment in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: On the Course Content page select the plus sign, Create, Assignment; a gradebook item is created automatically; add title, text, files, questions, visibility, due date.

question: Can I add a time limit to a group assignment in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: No: at this time a time limit cannot be added to group assignments.

question: How can I review my Blackboard course from a student's perspective?
expected: Use student preview to review the content and validate course behaviours such as conditional release and how grades appear.

question: Where do I find the course gradebook in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: Inside the course, on the navigation bar at the top right: select the Gradebook icon.

question: What are the two views of the Blackboard Ultra gradebook?
expected: List view (gradable items list and student list) and student grid view; toggle at the top left.

question: How do I post grades to students from the Blackboard gradebook?
expected: In the student grid, select the Post option in the column header when ready to release grades.

question: How do I make Blackboard assign zeros to missing work automatically?
expected: Gradebook Settings icon, select Assign automatic zeros for past due work, then Assign Zeros; enabled by default in new courses.

question: How do I download the gradebook from Blackboard?
expected: Select the down-arrow icon to open the Download Gradebook panel; choose full gradebook or columns, CSV or XLS, and the location.

question: How do I set accommodations for a student in the Blackboard gradebook?
expected: In the Students tab select the three-dot menu at the end of the student row and choose Accommodations; exempt from due dates or time limits.

question: How do I add an attendance row to the Blackboard gradebook?
expected: Select the plus sign where you want to add a row and choose Add Attendance; the option disappears once added.

question: How long can the title of a gradebook item be in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: The title is limited to 255 characters.

question: How do I filter the Blackboard gradebook by merged child courses?
expected: In the student grid view select Filter to open the Filter Criteria panel; the filter appears only for merged courses.

question: What can I change from the Gradebook Settings panel in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: The default grading schema, automatic zeros for missing past-due work, gradebook categories, rubrics.

question: How do I transfer grades from Blackboard to Banner?
expected: In the Grade Transfer Dashboard search the course by Course ID and Term, click View Details, click Transfer; after Chair and Dean approval the grade shows under the Banner column.

question: Where is the Grade Transfer Dashboard link?
expected: In the announcement on the Blackboard Institution Page, or directly at https://op.sharjah.ac.ae/GradeTransfer.

question: Who approves the grade transfer to Banner?
expected: The Chair and the Dean approve, by selecting Transfer in the Grade Transfer portal.

question: How can I find my course in the Grade Transfer Dashboard?
expected: Use the search bar at the top of the dashboard; search by Course ID and Term.

question: How does a Dean approve grades in the Grade Transfer portal?
expected: Open https://op.sharjah.ac.ae/GradeTransfer, log in, select the role, search and select the course, revise grades and approve by selecting Transfer.

question: How do I access iThenticate?
expected: Open www.ithenticate.com, click login, type the university e-mail and the password (activation password sent by ithenticate.com); e-mail servicedesk@sharjah.ac.ae if access fails.

question: How do I upload a document to iThenticate?
expected: Select Upload a File under Submit a Document, enter the author name and document title, Choose a File, Upload; the analysis may take a few hours.

question: How many documents can I submit to iThenticate per year?
expected: CONFLICT: the English page states a maximum of 30 documents per year, the Arabic page of the same file states 15. The runtime must not serve either value as a direct Plan F answer.

question: What is the maximum file size for an iThenticate upload?
expected: Files must be less than 100 MB (and at most 400 pages, 2 MB of raw text, at least 20 words).

question: Whom do I e-mail if I cannot access iThenticate?
expected: servicedesk@sharjah.ac.ae

question: How do I upload a revised version of my paper to iThenticate without it counting as a new document?
expected: Use Upload a New Revision instead of upload file; a revision is not counted as an extra document.

question: Where do I find the similarity report in iThenticate?
expected: Under Documents: click the report percentage to open the similarity report; resources can be excluded with Exclude resource.

question: When must final grades be submitted and how do I transfer them to Banner?
expected: Handbook page 224 (grade submission deadline) plus the Grade Transfer Dashboard steps on guide page 2; a safe answer covers both or falls back.

question: What does the handbook say about plagiarism in research, and how do I check a paper with iThenticate?
expected: A handbook research-integrity statement plus the iThenticate upload steps on guide page 1; a safe answer covers both or falls back.

question: How do I submit final grades?
expected: Ambiguous between the handbook grading policy (page 224) and the Grade Transfer Dashboard procedure (guide page 2); either source is acceptable, fallback is acceptable.

question: How do I reset my Blackboard password?
expected: No approved document states a password reset procedure: no guide chunk should be presented as the answer; fallback expected.

question: How do I enter grades in Banner Self Service directly?
expected: The guides describe the transfer dashboard, not direct Banner entry: fallback expected.

question: What is the Turnitin similarity threshold for a thesis?
expected: Not stated in any approved English document (the Turnitin guides are not ingested; iThenticate is a different tool): fallback expected.

question: How do I start the Phase 2 progress review in the HR Portal?
expected: The Performance Appraisal guide is on INGESTION HOLD (Internal Use) and is not indexed: no appraisal content may appear; fallback expected.

question: How many credit hours is a full teaching load?
expected: Unchanged from the I-9 baseline (served, page 91).

question: How many theses can a faculty member supervise at once?
expected: Unchanged from the I-9 baseline (served, page 81).

question: What is the phone number of the Human Resources Department?
expected: Unchanged from the I-9 baseline (served, page 54).

question: What does Human Resources do?
expected: The known wrong supported answer of the frozen HR specialist must never be served (I-1 regression case): fallback expected, unchanged from the baseline.

question: How many days of annual leave do faculty members get?
expected: The misleading partial result must never be served (I-1 regression case): fallback expected, unchanged from the baseline.

question: Does HR arrange travel and hotel accommodations for new faculty members?
expected: Unchanged from the I-9 baseline (served, page 61).
